rule: The first pair shows a pinwheel/swastika turned into its mirror image (a flip, not a rotation, since the shape is symmetric under 180 degree rotation). The same flip should be applied to the U-arrow (opening up, arrowhead up on the right). No option is an exact pure mirror, so the best fit is the one that is flipped to an arch with the arrowhead pointing down.
options_check: 1: identical to the given arrow, no change, so no. 2: arch opening down, arrowhead pointing down, shaded band on the other end; it is the vertical flip (combined with a left-right swap, i.e. a 180 degree turn), closest to a flip, so best fit. 3: C opening right, arrowhead at bottom pointing right, a 90 degree clockwise rotation, not a flip. 4: same as 3 with a flatter shape, a rotation, not a flip. 5: C opening left, arrowhead top-left pointing left, a 90 degree counter-clockwise rotation, not a flip.
redraw_diffs: Redraw keeps the same arrow orientations for all five options and the same pinwheel mirror pair. Differences are only cosmetic: line weight, band shape and shading details, and options 3 and 4 are drawn with slightly different curvature. None of these change the answer.
